name: pwa-install-prompt
summary: An install-as-app banner handling Android's beforeinstallprompt and iOS Safari's Add-to-Home-Screen instructions separately, with session-scoped dismissal.

peer.tailwindcss: assumed for styling; functional without it

rename.why: iOS branch heading. Rename to your app.
Android branch heading. Separate markup, so renaming only one leaves the other wrong on the platform you did not test.

caveats: Requires a web app manifest with icons and a registered service worker. Without them beforeinstallprompt never fires and the banner silently never appears.
Dismissal is sessionStorage-scoped and returns on a new tab. Move the key to safeLocalStorage to persist it.
Render it once, in the root layout.
